v: pu॰ anu + naSa--GaY । anumaraRe । adUradeSAdAvarTe saNkASAdi॰ Rya AnunASyaH tadadUradeSAdO tri॰ ।
pu॰ anurUpoHnAdaH prA॰ sa॰ । pratiDvanO pratiSabde anurUpaSabde ।
m: अनु-नाद m. sound, vibration, Śiś.
reverberation, echo.
a: अनुनादः — [अनुरूपो नादः] Sound, noise; Śi. 7. 18; reverberation, echo.

v: tri॰ anu + nadati anu + nada--Rini । pratirUpa SabdakArake “gamBIreRAnunAdineti” rAmA॰ ।
m: अनु-नादिन् mfn. resounding, echoing, resonant.
अनु-नादित mfn. made to resound.
अनुनासिकादि m. a compound letter commencing with a nasal.
अनुनासिकान्त m. a radical ending in a nasal.

v: tri॰ anugato nAsikAm atyA॰ sa॰ । nAsikayA saha svasvasTAnenoccAryyamARezu varRaBedeza । te ca “amo'nunAsikA na hrO” iti SikzAyAM darSitAH hakArarakAraBinnAH ampratyaharAntargatAH varRAH । “muKanAsikAvacano'nunAsika” iti pARinyuktestezAM tattatsTAnasahitanAsikayoccAryyamARatvAttattvam “upadeSe'janunAsika” iti pA॰ । ampratyAhAramaDye raBinnA yabalAH niranunAsikAH sAnunAsikASca tatrAnunAsikasTAne utpannayavalAmeva sAnunAsikatvam “yalodviDA'ro niranunAsikaH sAnunAsikaH । Yamo'nunAsikastena tatsTAne sAnunAsika” ityaBiyuktokteH yaTA yayya~myate vidvAlli~Kati, sarvvatsaraH anye niranunAsikAH । vetyanuvfttO “aRo'pragfhyasyAnunAsika” iti pARityukterapragfhyA evARo'nunAsikAH ।
m: अनु-नासिक mfn. nasal, uttered through the nose (as one of the five nasal consonants, or a vowel, or the three semivowels य्, व्, ल्, under certain circumstances; in the case of vowels and semivowels, the mark ँ is used to denote this nasalization)
the nasal mark ँ
अनु-नासिक n. a nasal twang
speaking through the nose (a fault in pronunciation).
a: अनुनासिक — a. [अनुगतो नासिकां] 1 Nasal, pronounced through the nose; मुखसहितनासिकया उच्चार्यमाणो वर्णोऽनुनासिकसंज्ञः स्यात् Sk.; मुखनासिकावचनोऽनुनासिकः P. I. 1. 8; अमोऽ नुनासिका न थौ Śikṣā; अनुनासिक being a name for the 5 nasal consonants, the vowels or the consonants य्, व्, ल् (under certain circumstances); i. e. the letters included in the प्रत्याहार अम् except ह् and र्. --2 The sign used to mark the nasalization in the case of य्, व् or ल्. --कं The nasal twang. --Comp. --आदिः a conjunct consonant beginning with a nasal.

m: अनु-नासिक—लोप m. dropping of a nasal sound or letter.
अनु-नासिक—त्व n. nasality.
अनुनासिकोपध mfn. having a nasal penultimate
succeeding a syllable with a nasal sound.
अनु-नायक mf(इका)n. submissive, humble.

v: strI anugatA nAyikAm । nAyikAnugatAyAm “saKI prabrajitA dAsI prezyA DAtreyikA taTA । anyASca SilpakAriRyo vijYeyA hyanunAyikA” ityuktadAsyAdo ।
m: अनु-नायिका f. a female character subordinate to a नायिका or leading female character in a drama.

a: अनुनायिक — a. Conciliating; प्रियतमेषु वधूरनुनायिका Śi. 6. 7. --का A female character subordinate to the Nāyikā or leading character, such as a friend, nurse, maidservant &c.; सखी प्रव्रजिता दासी प्रेष्या धात्रेयिका तथा . अन्याश्च शिल्पकारिण्यो विज्ञेया ह्यनुनायिकाः ..

m: अनु-√ नी (Subj. 2. sg. -नयस्; aor. Subj. 2. sg. -नेषि, 2. pl. -नेषथा) to bring near, lead to, RV.; to induce, win over, conciliate, pacify, supplicate.
a: अनुनी — {c1c} P. 1 To conciliate, win over, induce, persuade, prevail upon; request, supplicate, entreat, propitiate, pacify, appease (anger &c.); स चानुनीतः प्रणतेन पश्चात् R. 5. 54; विग्रहाच्च शयने पराङ्मुखीर्नानुनेतुमबलाः स तत्वरे 19. 38, 43; Bk. 6. 137; 5. 46, त्वत्संगमेन मम तत्तदिवानुनीतं V. 3. 20 pacified, made favourable or agreeable; Ki. 13. 67; M. 5; K. 168, 178; Dk. 3, 4, 7. --2 To cherish love; विद्विषोप्यनुनय Bh. 2. 77; cf. Shakespeare “Cherish those hearts that hate thee”. --3 To bring near to (with dat. of person). --4 To train, discipline. --5 To honour.

v: tri॰ anu + nI--kta । kftAnunaye yasya sAntvanArTaM vinayAdikaM kriyate tasmin । “sa cAnunIto'pi BfSaM cukopeti” BAratam ।
m: अनु-नीत mfn. disciplined, taught
obtained
respected
pleased, pacified
humbly entreated.
अनु-नीति f. conciliation, courtesy, supplication.
a: अनुनीतिः — = अनुनय q. v.; सानुनीतिश्च सीतायै नाक्रुध्यत् Bk. 8. 75 adopting a conciliatory tone; Śi. 16. 55.

m: अनु-√ नद् to sound towards (acc.) : Caus. P. -नादयति, to make resonant or musical.
a: अनुनद् — {c1c} P. To sound towards or at (with acc.). --Caus. To cause to sound, make resonant, fill with echo; पृथिवीं चांतरिक्षं च सागरांश्चानुनादयन्; साधु साध्विति नादेन पृथिवीमन्वनादयन्; विहंगैरनुनादितं Mb. made musical or resonant.

m: अनु-नदि ind. along the river, Dharmaś.
अनु-√ नम् Ā. to incline to, RV. v, 32, 10 : Caus. P. -नामयति, to cause to bow, BhP.
अनु-√ नन्द् to enjoy.
अनुनयामन्त्रण n. conciliatory address.

s: puM, (anu + nI + BAve ac .) vinayaH । (“kaTaM nu Sakyo'nunayomaharzerviSrARanAccAnyapayasvinInAm” । iti raGuvaMSe .) tatparyyAyaH । praRipAtaH 2 praRatiH 3 । iti hemacandraH ॥ (sadAcAraH । kroDopanayaH । “evaM rAmavacaH SrutvA lakzmaRAnunayaM taTA” । iti rAmAyaRaM .)
v: pu॰ anu + nI + ac । vinaye, praRipAte, prArTane, sAntvane ca । “kaTaM nu? Sakyo'nunayomaharzerviSrARanAdanyapayasvinInAmiti” raGuH ।
m: अनु-नय &c. See अनु-√ नी.
अनु-नय m. conciliation, salutation, courtesy, civility, showing respect or adoration to a guest or a deity
humble entreaty or supplication, reverential deportment
regulation of conduct, discipline, tuition
अनु-नय mfn. conciliatory, kind
a: अनुनय — a. [नी-अच्] Kind, conciliatory, pacifying (as words). --यः 1 Conciliation, propitiation, pacification (of anger), friendly persuasion; कथं नु शक्योऽनुनयो महर्षेर्विश्राणनाच्चान्यपयस्विनीनां R. 2. 54; कथं वा तेषामनुनयः कृतः H. 4; प्रकृतिवक्रः स कस्यानुनयं प्रतिगृह्णाति Ś. 4. --2 Courtesy, civility, courteous or polite behaviour, modesty, modest or respectful deportment, conciliatory act (such as salutation); showing respect (to a guest, deity &c.); विविधैरनुतप्यंते दयितानुनयैर्मनस्विन्यः V. 3. 5; दयितजन˚ 2. 22; वाक्यैः स्निग्धैरनुनयो भवेदर्थस्य साधनं S. D. 458. --3 An humble supplication or entreaty, a request in general; भद्र प्रियं नः . किंतु त्वदभिप्रायापरिज्ञानांतरितोऽ यमस्मदनुनयः Mu. 2; R. 6. 2; निषेधवाक्यालंकारजिज्ञासानुनये खलु Ak; ˚आमंत्रणं conciliatory address. --4 Discipline, training, regulation of conduct. --यः adv. Fitly, suitably.

m: अनु-नयम् ind. fitly, becomingly.
अनु-नयमान mfn. conciliating, honouring.
अनु-नय—प्रतिघ-प्रहाण n. abandoning the obstacles to conciliatory behaviour, Buddh.
अनु-नयिन् mfn. courteous, supplicating.
a: अनुनयिन् — a. Courteous, polite, humble, supplicating.

v: tri॰ anu + nI--karmaRi yat । anunayakaraRArhe, anunetuM yogye ca ।
m: अनु-नेय mfn. to be conciliated, Mṛcch.
अनु-√ नृत् to dance after (acc.), R.; Kathās.; to dance before (acc.), MBh.
अनु-निधानम् ind. according to position, in right order, Gobh.
अनु-निशीथम् ind. at midnight, Kir.
1. अनु-नि-√ शम् (ind.p. -शम्य) to hear, perceive, BhP.; to consider, MBh. xii, 6680.
2. अनु-निशम् ind. every night, Kathās. &c.
अनु-नि-√ क्रम् -क्रामति (Subj. -क्रामात्) to follow in the steps, TS.; ŚBr.
अनु-√ निक्ष् to pierce along, AV.
अनु-निनीषा f. the wish to propitiate, HPariś.
अनु-निनीषु mfn. desirous of conciliating.
अनु-नि-√ पद् -पद्यते, to lie down by the side of ŚBr.; Kauś.
अनु-निर्-√ दह् (Imper. 2. sg. -दह) to burn down in succession, AV. ix, 2, 9.
अनु-निर्देश m. description or relation following a previous model.
a: अनुनिर्देशः — Description or relation following the previous order or sequence; भूयसामुपदिष्टानां क्रियाणामथ कर्मणाम् . क्रमशो योऽनुनिर्देशो यथासंख्यं तदुच्यते S. D.

m: अनु-निर्-जिहान mfn. (pr.p. Ā. √ 2. हा), proceeding out of BhP.
अनु-निर्-√ 2. वा -वाति, to become extinct, go out after.
अनु-निर्वाप्या (आ), f. N. of a ceremony, KauṣBr.
a: अनुनिर्वाप्या — A ceremony connected with this libation.

m: अनु-निर्वाप्य mfn. to be taken out and shared subsequently, TS.
अनु-निर्-√ 2. वप् to take out from for scattering or sharing subsequently, TS.; ŚBr. &c.
अनु-नि-√ तुद् (impf. 3. pl. -अतुदन्) to wound with a stab, goad, PBr.
अनु-नि-√ वृज् (impf. 3. sg. -वृणक्) to plunge into (loc.), RV. vii, 18, 12.
अनु-नि-√ वृत् Caus. -वर्तयति, to bring back, AitBr.
अनु-नि-√ युज् to attach to, place under the authority of AitBr.; PBr.; Kāṭh.
अन्-उन्माद m. not being mad, soberness, MaitrS.
अन्-उन्माद mfn. = अन्-उन्मत्त.
a: अनुन्माद, --अनुन्मत्त — a. Not mad or frantic, sober, calm, sane.

m: अन्-उन्मदित mfn. id., AV. vi, 111, 1-4.
अन्-उन्मत्त mfn. not mad, sane, sober, not wild.
अनुन्नतानत mfn. not raised nor lowered, level.
अन्-उन्नत mfn. not elevated, not lifted up.
a: अनुन्नत — a. Not raised or elevated, not lifted up. --Comp. --आनत a. level (neither raised nor lowered). --गात्र a. having limbs not stout or prominent.

m: अन्-उन्नत—गात्र mfn. having limbs that are not too stout, prominent or protuberant, Buddh.
अनु-√ 4. नु Intens. (impf. 3. pl. -नोनवुर्; pr. p. nom. pl. m. -नोनुवतस्) to follow with acclamations of praise, RV. i, 80, 9 and viii, 92, 33.
